source: Electricity: per capita availability of power, kilowatt-hours, 2023-24, Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 138 (34 states and UTs; per capita figures use population projections of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare). Income: per-capita net state domestic product, current prices, 2023-24, same Handbook, Table 19 (33 states and UTs with data).
hook_vo: Chhattisgarh had almost twice West Bengal's power available per person at level income.

facts.vo: One lakh forty-nine thousand rupees a year, level with West Bengal.

facts.vo: Chhattisgarh had thirteen hundred and twenty-one kilowatt-hours available per person, above India's.

facts.text: kilowatt-hours a year: below India's. Chhattisgarh had 1.9 times that, at the same income.
